Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including 82 sites with detailed data on building age, size, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans (Vol 1, Ch 1, 2). Robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility with multiple data sources and connection to student outcomes and capital planning (Vol 1, Ch 2, sections 2.5-2.7).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment history and projections by school and grade level with methodology and assumptions explained (Vol 1, Ch 1.4). Capacity utilization data by site and grade with square footage and student numbers included. Explicit connection of enrollment projections to facility actions including school closures, consolidations, and adaptive uses (Vol 1, Ch 1.4, 4).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning (Vol 1, Ch 1.8, 6). Comprehensive educational specifications developed through collaborative process addressing 21st-century learning, technology, safety, sustainability, and community use. Facility projects directly respond to educational goals including STEM, CTE, special education, and collaborative learning spaces (Vol 1, Ch 6).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Outdoor greening and climate-adapted design are central elements of the plan with districtwide data on green surfaces, shade coverage, and stormwater management (Vol 1, Ch 2.5, 4). Detailed strategies for campus greening including tree cover expansion, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, and bioswales. Outdoor learning and environmental literacy are explicitly referenced as part of the holistic approach (Vol 1, Ch 4, 6).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate impacts and resilience strategies in detail, including HVAC upgrades for air quality, shade structures, and energy resilience (Vol 1, Ch 2.5, 5). Climate readiness is a theme in the plan and integrated into assessment and long-range planning, though comprehensive districtwide climate risk assessment for multiple impacts is less explicit than highest level (Vol 1, Ch 2, 5).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy resilience and efficiency are core parts of the plan with detailed energy use data, strategies for electrification, renewable integration, and resilience (solar + storage, microgrids) (Vol 1, Ch 2.5, 5). References to Title 24, Zero Net Energy goals, and state mandates are included. The plan connects energy improvements to cost savings, emissions reductions, and climate-related disruptions (Vol 1, Ch 5).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects, including escalation and contingencies (Vol 1, Ch 5). Clear prioritization framework with criteria-based ranking and phased project implementation. Multiple funding strategies outlined including bonds, state programs, developer fees, and alternative financing. Long-term financial sustainability and alignment with educational priorities demonstrated (Vol 1, Ch 5).
